trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/bug72402.phpt","function":"<global>","line":15,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_ereg_replace_callback(\"(a*)*\", function($m){ return \"\"; }, str_repeat(\"a\", 10000));","note":"The attacker provides a nested empty-match quantifier pattern to the callback-based replace API, exercising the empty-repeat compiler path under heavy input."},
{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern","line":None,"var":"pattern","code":"The mbstring wrapper compiles the pattern and prepares callback-driven replacement execution.","note":"The regex engine parses the nested quantifiers before replacement begins, so the vulnerable compile-time state is established here."},
{"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5518,"var":"NODE_QUANT","code":"case NODE_QUANT: r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"The AST for the nested quantifier reaches the quantifier tuning path that sets emptiness and empty-check metadata."},
{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"The compiler classifies the repeated body using the memory-aware emptiness helper, which is central to the crash signature."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"The recursive classifier walks the nested quantifier/capture tree derived from the attacker input."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4928,"var":"BAG_MEMORY","code":"case BAG_MEMORY: return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_MEM;","note":"Capture-memory nodes are marked as empty-memory, enabling the later empty-check op emission that the bug mismanages."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"compile_tree","line":1044,"var":"OP_EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST","code":"else if (emptiness == BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_MEM) { ... add_op(reg, OP_EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST); }","note":"Compilation emits empty-check instructions for memory-bearing empty repeats, directly depending on the earlier classification."},
{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"compile_tree","line":1044,"var":"replacement execution","code":"compile_tree(body, reg, env);","note":"The compiled automaton is then used by the callback replace runtime, which is expected to expose the heap-use-after-free read when processing repeated matches."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
PY
